scope: Specified SmPC sections only; not integral guideline/product review or a prescription

products.discrepancy: A universal cumulative ceiling of 4 mg/kg is unsupported.
products.renal_and_age_limits: At age <=3 months with renal impairment, data are absent: caution and lower cumulative exposure (<0.5 mg/kg) may be considered. End-stage renal disease with/without dialysis lacks established safety/efficacy.
products.indication_boundary: Acute symptomatic medicine/chemical-induced methaemoglobinaemia; newborn/infant dosing differs.
products.interaction_boundary: Serotonergic medicines/opioids carry severe serotonin-syndrome risk; avoid combination, with specific unavoidable-use precautions in 4.5.
products.pharmaceutical_boundaries: No mixing except specified exceptions; sodium chloride 0.9% reduces solubility. Optional dilution: 50 mL glucose 5%. Single use; particle/precipitate inspection.
products.access_limits: EN and subsequent ES requests were rate-limited (429). ES clinical and PT pharmaceutical focal sections were obtained; no integral translation-parity claim.

products.product: Voraxaze 1000 units powder for solution for injection
products.indication_boundary: Adults and children >=28 days with delayed methotrexate elimination or toxicity risk; timing/thresholds depend on MTX regimen and protocol.
products.label_anchor: Single 50 units/kg IV over 5 minutes. No recommended renal dose adjustment; no data below 28 days.
products.timing_boundary: Optimal delayed-elimination window 48-60 hours from high-dose MTX start is not an absolute loss-of-effect cutoff.
products.folinic_boundary: Separate folinic acid by at least two hours before/after glucarpidase; intracellular rescue remains necessary.
products.assay_boundary: DAMPA distorts immunoassays; HPLC is preferred. Forty-eight hours is not a universal guarantee of reliable immunoassay results; interference can persist longer.
products.contraindication: Active-substance/excipient hypersensitivity; monitor allergic reactions and retain MTX/renal surveillance and supportive care.
products.pharmaceutical_boundaries: Reconstitute a vial with 1 mL sterile sodium chloride 0.9%; no further dilution. Flush line before/after. No mixing without compatibility data.
products.not_transcribed: Regimen-dependent MTX intervention tables and additional folate interactions remain at exact source locators; no universal table reconstructed.
